headline: One photo, 407 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 827548fcd5ca) is attached to 407 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 407 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Other (346), Contour Trench (57), Bore-Well Recharge (4).
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
